physicalDescription: Dark curls, tremendous eyebrows, talks with both hands and occasionally a wooden spoon, permanently windswept like he's in a perfume advert nobody commissioned.
clothingStyle: Linen shirt unbuttoned exactly two buttons, gold chain, and an apron that materialises from thin air the second he feels an emotion.
voiceDescription: Rich, operatic, emotional; whispers a secret and then declaims to the heavens mid-sentence.
accentDirection: Melodic Italian accent, warm and theatrical, fully intelligible.
personality: Grand romantic living at full orchestral volume. Cooks when stressed, so the villa smells incredible and nobody has slept. Sincerely believes food is a legally binding declaration of love.
datingStrategy: Seduction by eight-course tasting menu, devastating eye contact, and one tear he pretends is from the onions.
strength: His grand gestures are real — when Matteo shows up for someone, he shows up at 5am with fresh bread and a playlist.
fatalFlaw: Operatic jealousy: a borrowed sun-lounger becomes a family betrayal spanning generations by dinner service.
secret: He is lactose intolerant. The mozzarella devotion is a beautiful, agonising lie he suffers for nightly.
romanticPreference: Élodie (France) — 'She insulted my risotto. To my face. I must marry her.'
recurringJoke: Diagnoses every person and crisis as a dish ('You are gnocchi: soft, but you sink').
signaturePhrase: My heart is al dente — firm, but ready.
